versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 企业AI实施知识库 (Enterprise AI Knowledgebase) skill.
- Provides 8 key insights for enterprise AI adoption, including common pitfalls and success factors sourced from the Stanford Playbook and enterprise AI maturity research.
- Includes a 5-phase, 10-day teaching plan for building AI capabilities in organizations.
- Presents a 4-level capability roadmap to guide product managers from AI awareness to leading AI-driven business innovation.
- Designed for scenarios such as AI strategy consulting, implementation assessment, capability planning, vendor selection, and project preparation.
